note: The student's first learning curve (docs/STUDENT.md §5, §7, §12 item 2): from the base run's stored trick-2 teacher shards (student-t2-base-1: 40 rules and 10 mixed parts of 5,000 decisions at 320 deals, the fixed test set of 2 x 2,048 decisions at 1,024 deals), students of 256-128 and 512-256 hidden units trained on the first 50,000, 100,000 and 250,000 decisions (the parts spread four rules to one mixed), each measured on the test set with search student-check beside the rules bot and a random card. Fetches about 9.3 GB of shards (a few minutes at 1 Gbps, about 13 at 100 Mbps), encodes them once, then trains six networks on the GPU; each finished (size, width) pair survives a lost machine. Outputs: out/student/curve.txt and curve.json, and per pair the float and integer networks (the integer ones also in inputs/sha256).
